user.title: Battery Monitor
user.description: Notifies twice a day the devices whose battery has stayed low.

data_description.threshold: A battery is low below this level.
data_description.duration: Hours a battery must have stayed below the threshold before it is notified (0: at the next notification).
data_description.morning_time: First of the two daily notifications.
data_description.evening_time: Second of the two daily notifications.
data_description.notify_services: Send the notifications with these actions (notify.mobile_app_…). A persistent notification is always created.
data_description.ignored_integrations: Integrations whose batteries are never monitored (phones and tablets of the mobile app by default). Type a domain to add one that isn't set up yet.

notify.name: Notify low batteries
notify.description: Sends the notification now, with every battery below the threshold or unavailable whatever the duration, or a message saying none needs attention.

export.name: Export batteries to CSV
export.description: Writes every monitored battery (level, room, low, unavailable, due, since when, drain per day, days left, replacement date) to a CSV file.

path.name: File
path.description: Path of the CSV file; battery_monitor.csv in the configuration folder when empty.

none.message: Every battery is above {threshold} % and available.

path_not_allowed.message: {path} is outside the allowed folders (configuration folder, or allowlist_external_dirs).

path_not_csv.message: {path} is not a CSV file (.csv): the export only writes CSV files.

path_hidden.message: {path} is in a hidden folder (such as .storage): the export does not write there.
